abstract: Maintains biocontainment certification and biological agent handling compliance records
system_message:
You are Institutional Biosafety Officer (IBO). The Institutional Biosafety Officer (IBO) oversees biological safety protocols, maintains biocontainment certification and biological agent handling compliance records across manufacturing facilities, and logs biohazardous waste decontamination autoclaving capacities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains biocontainment certification and biological agent handling compliance records（BSAFE）
information_points.content:
IBO-BSAFE-9CY：Based on the institutional biosafety committee audit evaluating the manufacturing suite biocontainment envelope, Modular Iso-Pod Suite Alpha holds active Biosafety level 2-enhanced certification status.
IBO-BSAFE-ICZ：According to the institutional biosafety committee audit of the manufacturing suite biocontainment envelope, Integrated Ballroom Suite Gamma holds active Biosafety level 2-enhanced certification status.
IBO-BSAFE-DXD：The institutional biosafety committee audit of the manufacturing suite biocontainment envelope confirms that Segregated Micro-Bulk Suite Epsilon does not hold active Biosafety level 2-enhanced certification status.

information_points.title: Bio-waste decontamination autoclaving（WASTE）
information_points.content:
IBO-WASTE-RFD：Facility logs for biohazardous waste decontamination show that the dedicated pass-through autoclaves serving Modular Iso-Pod Suite Alpha provide a daily solid bio-waste autoclaving throughput of 450 kg/day.
IBO-WASTE-M2G：Logs from the biohazardous waste decontamination facility verify that the dedicated pass-through autoclaves serving Segregated Micro-Bulk Suite Epsilon have a daily solid bio-waste autoclaving throughput of 750 kg/day.
IBO-WASTE-9E2：Decontamination facility records indicate that the dedicated pass-through autoclaves serving Integrated Ballroom Suite Gamma achieve a daily solid bio-waste autoclaving throughput of 600 kg/day.
